description: Historical GTFS and GTFS Realtime is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. This dataset contains historical GTFS and GTFS Realtime data. The GTFS Realtime data includes GTFS vehicle position, GTFS trip update and GTFS timetable. Initially, it provides Metro and Ferry data and include other modes over time. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are GTFS Realtime, ferry, gtfs, historic, historical. It offers 2 resource(s) in api, pdf. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
